execution.extraction: Offline bounded report extraction only; no new browser, replay, suite, pack or runtime command.
execution.root_verification: Root separately verified all611 indexed export files and selected host modules equal SDK19. This extraction uses that hashed validation record.
execution.load_scope: Root held its own browser/tests/build/pack during measured FPS. Human retained parallel projects; no machine-wide CPU/GPU isolation is claimed.
execution.no_gate_changes: All18 case criteria and all3 benchmark/analysis/preparation hashes are identical. Original failed run is retained. Legacy completion-end failures and nominal phase overruns are preserved; every releaseReady value remains false.

original_plan.purpose: One predeclared full comparison after restoring the SDK17 tab configuration; not proof that extra tab caused the earlier failure.

observation.resolution: New blank did not hide public title. Closed only agent-created public title tab10; user localtab2 left unchanged. Remaining tabs2 and11(blank), matching original17 composition2+blank5.

original_plan.next: If full control passes, run original60s idle/inventory. If any case fails, preserve and change to host diagnostic; no repeated acceptance sampling.
limits: No direct measure of background title cost; tab correlation is not causal attribution.

environment_control.actual_observation: The owner observed public title tab10 still visible with hidden=false even after creating/selecting blank11. Only that agent-created public title was closed; user local tab2 stayed unchanged, alongside blank11, to match the SDK17 local+blank composition.
environment_control.decision: One predeclared full eight-case comparison. The plan allowed the original60-second idle/inventory cases only if that whole control passed; if it failed, preserve it and move to diagnostics rather than repeated acceptance sampling.
environment_control.causal_limit: No direct measurement isolates public-title cost. This single nonrandomized environmental control is not proof the extra title caused the first failure; ambient parallel load remains a confounder.

limitations: Headless Chrome on this host, no exclusive CPU/GPU reservation. Compare candidates only under similar machine load.

Optional completion v1 adapter is checked against official candidate SDK documentation; this is not acceptance of a final SDK or game export. Old or unsupported SDKs fall back to official profile; absent either adequate evidence yields insufficient-evidence.

Completion v1 reports synchronous world/UI/cursor submissions. One-second samples establish sampled progress and interval percentiles, not OS display scanout, every intermediate frame ordering or UI pixel correctness. Current map/battle UI progress is checked at both boundaries; future scene2D needs its documented revision/transform adapter.

Legacy published dropped totals can be 29 draws stale; only a consistent v1 session supplies exact boundary counters. Sparse bridge/render samples cannot establish per-frame CPU tails; profile phase statistics and their measured overhead remain separate.
These short windows are focused regressions, not long soak or maximal army/dungeon stress acceptance.

interpretation.controlled_result: The predeclared baseline-tabs full control passes8/8; subsequent original idle/inventory60-second cases pass2/2. Reported measured dropped-step deltas are0, which does not erase nonzero preparation-era dropped totals shown in before/after counters.
interpretation.remaining_diagnostics: Every legacy completion-end gate remains false. Nominal-deadline misses, sparse CPU publication scope and separate resource/GC questions remain visible.

scope: Seven original scenarios plus inventory-during-travel; original failed short run, one predeclared full environmental control and original maintained idle/inventory60-second cases are all preserved.
